title: fix(import): the STEP edge-gap cap follows the tolerance that the file states
body:
## What changed

- **Edge cap** (`crates/kernel/src/step_edge_gap.rs`, new). An edge may lie off its face's surface by up to `clamp(2 x stated, 0.01 mm, 0.02 mm)`.
  - `stated` is the distance uncertainty of the file. Solidcore's units module reads it and converts it to mm, so an inch file converts. When there are several contexts, the least value is used.
  - A file that states no uncertainty, or zero, a negative value, NaN or infinity, keeps 0.01 mm (`MAX_EDGE_GAP_MM`).
  - No file can raise the cap past `EDGE_GAP_LIMIT_MM` = 0.02 mm.
  - `KernelTrims::with_cap` applies the cap to the gap check and to the pcurve lift check.
- **Refusal text** names the gap, the cap and the source of the cap. Example: `edge 0 lies 0.0210 mm off the face's surface, over the cap of 0.02 mm; the file states a tolerance of 0.01 mm, and the reader accepts twice that, from 0.01 mm to 0.02 mm`. The start of the old text is the same, so the pins of `bspline_discontinuous.step` (0.25 mm) did not change.
- **Looser mesh** (`crates/geometry/src/step.rs`). The importer meshes the model one more time at `min(2 x stated, 0.02 mm)` when all of these are true:
  - the machining mesh refuses at the chord (`FaceCapped`, `EdgeCapped` or `Deviation`);
  - the file states a tolerance;
  - a kept edge gap is larger than the chord.

  The importer hands out that chord. Thus the existing #864 law (`step::coarse` -> `coarse_mm` -> `ReducedFidelity` -> `model_fidelity`) flags the model. There is no second derivation of the fidelity law, and no schema or project-file change.
- **Notes.**
  - The importer note, in plain words. The geometry crate gives the facts, and the app adds what the fidelity law does at that chord (`geometry::import::step::loosened_consequence`, which reads the same law as `verdict_tol`). At 0.02 mm the note is: "This file's edges sit up to 0.018 mm off their surfaces. The file states a tolerance of 0.010 mm. The model is used at reduced accuracy (0.020 mm). A program cannot be posted while this model is in the document. Export the file again with a tighter tolerance to post one."
  - When the excess is inside `DEV_TOL`, the second part is: "Gouge checks against this model are stricter, and an operation that they cannot check is refused at the post."
  - The kernel note for each kept gap over 0.01 mm names the gap, the stated tolerance and the cap.
- **Advice texts for a coarse model (review fix).** The document does not record why a model has reduced accuracy. Issue #2996 adds that record; then each text names the one cause. Until then six texts name both remedies ("re-import with a larger STEP facet budget, or export the file again with a tighter tolerance"):
  - `model_fidelity::TOO_COARSE`;
  - the MCP note (`model_fidelity::facts`);
  - the `op_problem` refusal of a kind that cannot read the excess;
  - the vouch refusal of a recorded chord (`commands/vouch_fidelity.rs`);
  - the model-page hint (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`). This is a text change only; the page layout does not change, so there are no screenshots;
  - the `import_model` MCP tool description.
- Decision: `docs/decisions/2976-edge-gap-cap.md` (the maintainer chose option A on 2026-11-20).

## Measurement (local harness, not committed; cap off for the run)

| File | Stated (mm) | Edges measured | Largest gap (mm) | > 0.001 | > 0.005 | > 0.01 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lobe.step (private user file) | 0.01 | 28 | 1.015e-2 | 14 | 10 | 1 |
| fig8.step | 0.01 | 1 | 3.5e-12 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| fillet_corner.step | 1e-6 | 2 | 8.2e-13 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| bar_cross_holes.step | 2e-5 | 4 | 1.19e-6 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| bspline_discontinuous.step | 1e-6 | 3 | 0.25 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| the other 16 tracked models | 1e-14 to 0.01 | 0 | - | - | - | - |

`Lobe.step` with this PR (local run, numbers only): it imports. Chord 0.02 mm, 10640 facets, deviation 1.947e-2 mm. The mesh volume is 113192.5 mm3, and the exact kernel volume is 113295.5 mm3. It has the reduced-accuracy note ("up to 0.010 mm ... states a tolerance of 0.010 mm ... reduced accuracy (0.020 mm)"). The numbers are the same after the merge of `main` with #2934 (strip-face division in the mesher). At the chords 0.005 to 0.015 mm, the mesh refuses one face ("face 1 capped", sag up to 1.56e-2 mm).

## Cost (read this before the merge)

- 0.02 mm is coarser than the verdict tolerance of the stock simulation (`DEV_TOL` = 0.01 mm). A gouge of less than about 0.02 mm on such a model is not judged. The flag and the note tell the user.
- At a chord of 0.02 mm, the excess over `CHORD_CAP` is 0.015 mm. That is more than `DEV_TOL`, so `model_fidelity::verdict_tol` has no tolerance left.
- The program gate (`op_problem`) refuses an operation on such a model by name when the floor of the operation does not cover the excess. `VouchModelFidelity` does not apply to a recorded chord.
- `gate_problems` adds the `verdict_tol` refusal when no operation is refused by itself. Thus the post refuses each program while such a model is in the document, also when each operation leaves stock that covers the excess.

## Posting waits for #2996

The maintainer decided to widen the verdict tolerance for such a model in a follow-up. Until then, on a model that opens at 0.02 mm, the user can:
- open the model, see it, measure it, and set up stock and fixtures;
- make and generate operations (the gate names each operation that it cannot verify);
- read the reduced-fidelity flag and the note.

The user cannot post a program while this model is in the document. Refs #2996

## Pins (our own generated fixtures, `testdata/models/edge_gap/`; provenance in each header)

- `crates/kernel/tests/step_edge_gap.rs` (6 tests):
  - a gap of 0.018 mm with a stated 0.01 mm reads with the note, and the mesh refuses at 0.005 mm but meshes at 0.02 mm;
  - 0.021 mm is refused with the new text;
  - a stated 5 mm does not raise the cap past 0.02 mm, and the 0.021 mm step is refused by the mesh;
  - with no stated value, the cap stays 0.01 mm (0.009 mm reads at the kernel, 0.011 mm is refused by name);
  - the inch file converts (0.0003 in gives a cap of 0.01524 mm; 0.014 mm reads, 0.016 mm is refused);
  - `fig8`, `fillet_corner`, `bar_cross_holes` and `twisted_flank` keep tight gaps and no looser mesh.
- `crates/kernel/src/step_edge_gap.rs` unit tests (3): the clamp, NaN and limits, the refusal text, the loose-chord rule and the note text.
- `crates/geometry/tests/step_edge_gap.rs` (4 tests):
  - 0.018 mm meshes at a chord of 0.02 mm with the note first;
  - the inch file meshes at 0.01524 mm;
  - the file with no stated value (0.009 mm) and the file that states 5 mm are refused at the chord;
  - the over-cap files and `bspline_discontinuous` are refused at the cap;
  - the four tracked fixtures keep the chord of 0.005 mm.
- `crates/app/tests/import_step_edge_gap.rs` (2 tests):
  - `ImportModel` carries `coarse_mm = 0.02` and the full note, and `chord_of` after execute is 0.02;
  - the over-cap file is refused;
  - the four tracked fixtures keep `coarse_mm` `None`;
  - (third test) both branches of `loosened_consequence` (0.02, 0.01524, 0.012).
- Texts of the advice: the full new text in app `model_fidelity`, `coarse_laws`, `coarse_rims`, `fidelity_copies`; new asserts for the MCP note (`model_fidelity`), the vouch refusal (`vouch_fidelity`), and the page hint (ui `model_fidelity`, `model_incomplete`).
- Unchanged and green: `step_twisted_flank` (kernel, geometry, app), `import_step_guard_default_cap`, `import_step_guard`, and every kernel `step_agreement` row.

## Gate (head 7b2dba40d, after the merge of `main`; -j 18)

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --locked --no-fail-fast`: 22 binaries, 119 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- Geometry `step_csys_read`, `step_diag`, `step_edge_gap`, `step_metre_unit`, `step_twisted_flank`, `step_units`: 28 passed, 0 failed.
- App `import`, `import_bytes`, `import_outward`, `import_solidcraft`, `import_step_*` (12), `model_fidelity`, `step_chord_units`, `step_fidelity`, `vouch_fidelity`, `vouch_fidelity_mcp`, `stock_copy_hole`, `coarse_laws`, `coarse_rims`, `fidelity_copies`, `step_budget`, `pocket3d_hsm`: 26 binaries, 125 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored.
- `camcraft-ui` lib (from `crates/ui`): 1319 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy subset in release (`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --only ...`, 21 steps, 16.4 min, 0 failed):
  - every kernel heavy step (lib, bins, agreement, blend, heal_import, import_corpus, machining_mesh_shortfalls, mesh_deviation_bench, solidcraft_hostile, solidcraft_import, step_agreement, step_closed_form, step_edge_gap, step_import, step_twisted_flank, doc);
  - app `adaptive_fig8_crossing`, `import_solidcraft`, `large_models`;
  - the two known fails of #2845 (red as expected).
- The other heavy steps (`cargo xtask gate heavy --dry-run` lists 249 in all) go to the cut gate.

## Not exercised

- **Heavy lanes:** only the STEP, mesh, import and fidelity subset above ran. The other heavy steps go to the cut gate.
- The new fixtures are in `testdata/models/edge_gap/`, not at the top level. The `step_agreement` bench needs a recorded truck reading for each top-level fixture. The truck reader was removed in #2790, and a row with an invented reading would be false.
- A file that states a large tolerance does not reach the kernel's gap check: the reader fits those pcurves itself. Such a file is not meshed looser. The mesh refuses it by name at the chord.
- A file with no stated tolerance and a gap between 0.005 mm and 0.01 mm passes the edge check. The mesh refuses it at the chord, as before.
- No GUI run. The page shows the existing reduced-fidelity label, and the hint text changed (pinned in the ui tests).

Test build: from 364e4b4f4 (see the PR comment). The maintainer tested that build by hand. The review fixes and the merge of `main` came after it.

Effort: max (no escalation). Refs #917

Changelog: STEP import: the cap on how far an edge may lie off its surface now follows the tolerance that the file states (twice it, from 0.01 mm to 0.02 mm). A model whose edges stop the mesh at the normal accuracy is imported at reduced fidelity, with a note that names the gap and the file's tolerance.

Fixes #2976
